summary: Concentrated: 46 holdings, but the top ten are 67% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 60% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 4.7 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable, faster-growing and much larger.
Big sector bet: 32% in Information Technology.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 6 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1975; Williams College. Joined Julian Robertson's Tiger Management in 1997 and was given over $25 million to manage when it closed in 2000, starting Tiger Global.
profile.approach: Technology and internet companies in the US and China, in listed shares and early private stakes.
known: The hedge fund rose 48% in 2020, then fell 34% in the first three months of 2022 as technology shares slumped.
profile.note: Tiger Global's private investments are not in the 13F.
